name: istrellis
setup: t = poly2trellis(3,[6 7]); a = double(istrellis(t)); b = double(istrellis(struct('x',1))); c = double(istrellis(5));
comment: Sig: tf = istrellis(S). Validates a trellis struct: poly2trellis output -> 1 (a); a plain struct/scalar -> 0 (b, c). New (Error Correction Codes) 2026-06. MATLAB R2025b -batch may crash on comm-toolbox shutdown; istrellis verified via gtest + smoke.
